# About me

I am an applied mathematician specializing in **reduced-order modeling,
scientific machine learning, and numerical simulation of partial differential
equations**.

I obtained my PhD in Applied Mathematics from INSA Toulouse. My
doctoral research focused on developing fast and accurate reduced-order models
for the two-dimensional shallow-water equations, with applications to flood
and floodplain dynamics.

My work combines Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD), non-intrusive reduced
basis methods and neural-network surrogates, with the aim of bridging
mathematical modeling, numerical simulation and artificial intelligence to
build accurate and efficient computational methods.
